name: Creative Shock draws two cards, then discards one
notes: Creative Shock's element is FIRE (matching the starting champion), so no lineage patch is needed. Only the base 'draw 2, discard 1' is covered; the [Class Bonus] fire-discard damage clause is out of scope (no class bonus set up, and the discarded card isn't guaranteed FIRE).

rulesClauses: Draw two cards, then discard a card.
